entries.en: Founders and creators who present themselves every day start their morning the same way. Dull, tired looking skin is one of the most common reasons people start a serum routine. The PDRN Brightening Serum is built around PDRN and peptides, in a lightweight formula that helps skin look smooth and bright, morning and night.

Founders and creators who present themselves every day start their morning the same way. Fine lines are usually the first thing people want a serum for. This formula pairs acetyl hexapeptide-8 with PDRN, two ingredients chosen to support skin that looks smoother and brighter, in a single step, twice a day. No ten step routine required.

Founders and creators who present themselves every day start their morning the same way. Skin that feels tight and dry by midday is exactly what this serum is made for. A blend of glycerin, sodium PCA, and sodium hyaluronate provides deep hydration, while panthenol conditions the skin, so it feels comfortable and hydrated, not greasy.

Founders and creators who present themselves every day start their morning the same way. An uneven looking complexion is a common frustration. PDRN and peptides help skin look brighter and more even, and the lightweight formula absorbs quickly, in a simple step used twice a day.
Helps skin look brighter, more even, and smooth.
A peptide that works alongside PDRN to support skin that looks smoother and more even.
A hydration blend that draws in moisture, for skin that feels comfortable and smooth.
Conditions the skin, leaving it feeling soft and comfortable, a kind base for skin that reacts easily.
Week 1 — evenings only, every other night
From day 1 — morning and evening, twice daily
Slots in right after cleansing — one added step, about a minute.
Goes on after cleansing, before your moisturizer.
Layers after cleansing and before moisturizer and SPF — nothing to give up.
